blurb: Guests take helicopter tours ranging from 10 to 45 minutes to see Tampa Bay, Downtown Tampa, Bayshore Boulevard, and the Gulf Coast from above. Tours include short scenic flights and sunset or extended sightseeing flights. Flights are operated by FAA-certified pilots with safety as a priority.
extraNote: Flights postponed or rescheduled if weather conditions are not ideal · If poor weather makes flying unsafe, tour will be rescheduled or refunded · Booking in advance recommended; same-day bookings sometimes available · Heliport or airport near Tampa Bay, minutes from Downtown Tampa and major highways
